description: This Java source file contains integration tests for creating and updating savings products within the Apache Fineract project. It uses REST-assured for HTTP API testing and verifies various configurations related to overdraft and accounting rules.

classes.name: SavingsProductCreationIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration tests for savings product creation and update in the Apache Fineract project, focusing on overdraft and accounting configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST API specifications and helper objects before each test.

methods.name: testStandardSavingsProductCreation_DoesNotAllowOverdraft
methods.description: Tests creation of a savings product without overdraft allowance and verifies the interest receivable account is null.

methods.name: testSavingsProductWithOverdraftCreation_AllowsOverdraft
methods.description: Tests creation of a savings product with overdraft allowance and verifies the interest receivable account linkage.

methods.name: testSavingsProductWithOverdraftUpdate_AllowsOverdraft
methods.description: Tests updating an existing savings product to allow overdraft and updates the interest receivable account association.

methods.name: createSavingsProductWithAccrualAccountingWithOverdraftAllowed
methods.description: Helper method to create a savings product with accrual accounting rules and overdraft allowed, specifying interest receivable account.

methods.name: createSavingsProductWithAccrualAccountingWithOutOverdraftAllowed
methods.description: Helper method to create a savings product with accrual accounting rules without overdraft.

methods.name: updateSavingsProductWithAccrualAccountingWithOverdraftAllowed
methods.description: Helper method to update an existing savings product to allow overdraft with new interest receivable account.
